Added the result of one aggregate for one group, with how many values it is made of.
Added a number computed for each group.
Added everything UIMSD can show right now: the datasets with their rows, and the views onto them.
Added turns cells and aggregates into text.
Added how one cell is shown: its text and what kind of knowledge it is.
Added one column of a dataset: what it is called, what kind of value it holds, who may see it and how values of several log segments of one run combine.
Added a dataset's schema together with its rows, ready to be queried.
Added the schema of a dataset.
Added builds the Catalog from the raw logs: runs/*.apdlog (recorded runs) and legacy/*.apdlog (imported ranking records).
Added the shipped datasets and views.
Added one condition on one column.
Added group the rows by the values of some columns and compute aggregates for each group.
Added one group of a grouped result.

Added a way to move from a row of one dataset to the matching rows of another: "Items in this run" is a link from the Runs dataset to the Items dataset where the Items column "item.run" equals the Runs column "run.id".
Added what the assembly of datasets needs to know about one log (or import file) besides its rows.
Added everything one log contributes: its meta and the rows of each dataset.
Added what a filter does with its column.

Added everything that decides what a UIMSD screen shows, as plain immutable data: which dataset, which scope, which filters, how it is sorted, which columns, whether it is grouped, and whether hidden information of FINISHED runs may be shown.
Added a query as text and back.
Added runs a Query over a Dataset.
Added what a query produced, with everything needed to show it honestly: how many rows there were, what the scope and each filter cost, and how much of each column is actually known.
Added a QueryResult laid out as a table of text, for any screen to draw: headers (what to call each column, whether tapping it sorts, how much of it is known) and lines of CellText.
Added one row of a dataset.
Added turns one raw log into the rows of every dataset.
Added the compact binary form of one log's rows, for the row cache.
Added combines the rows that one logical run recorded in several log segments into one row, column by column, following each column's Merge rule.
Added which rows are in play before any filter.
Added order by a column (or, in a grouped result, by an aggregate's id).
Added the lines of the status strip above a UIMSD table: how many rows there are, what the scope and the filters left out, and how much of the data is actually known.
Added where the columns and rows of a ResultTable go, in screen units.

Added everything a UIMSD screen is, apart from the pixels: which view is open, the query being edited, the result, the page, and the moves between them (open a view, add a filter, click a header, follow a link, go back).

Added the device self-test for UIMSD: writes a small made-up history, builds the datasets from it twice (from the logs, then from the row cache), queries them (including a hidden-information check) and times it on this device.
Added a named way into a dataset: the dataset plus a starting query.
Exposed flush-for-reading support to the new statistics screen.
Extended self-checks to the statistics-query system.
Added uIMSD, the Ultimate Infinite Mega Statistics Database.
Added the table of a UIMSD screen.
Added access to the first usable UIMSD tables and query controls.
Added which columns the table shows.
Added adding and editing a UIMSD filter, step by step: column, operator, value.
Added the one list window all the UIMSD pickers use (columns, operators, values, views, options and so on).
Added the options of a UIMSD screen: hidden information, which rulesets and which runs are in scope, the minimum sample size, grouping, and the explanations of coverage and markers.
Added everything about one row (or one group) of a UIMSD table, value by value, with what kind of knowledge each value is, and the links to the matching rows of other datasets.
Added the sort keys of a UIMSD table (up to three).
Added every line of the status strip in full.
Added a title and a scrolling block of text, for the UIMSD explanations (coverage, what the markers mean).
